Name: Gender Neutrality Mod Tokens
Author: Hanatsuki
Description:
[color=#00ff00]For Regular Users:[/color] Install the mod like any SMAPI mod then edit the config using Generic Mod Config Menu (or manually) in a similar way to the base Gender Neutrality Mod. (I will add more specific instructions later, for now read the GNM page for more help)



[color=#ff0000]For Modders:[/color] To use this mod simply install Content Patcher and call the tokens listed in the config file in your content file. For example, if you wanted the dialogue to say "I like them/her/him" You would write "I like {{Hana.GNMTokens/ObjectivePronoun}}" and it would replace the token with whatever the user provided in that config slot. Further use details will be added later.

If anyone needs any other tokens added please message me or leave a comment.

Source code [url=https://github.com/aeremyns/GNMTokensMod]here[/url]﻿. (I think I used GitHub right, please let me know if there are issues)

Downloads.Description: Config options have been reverted to pre-3.0.0 options. Please delete your config file and reset your setting. Apologies for the inconvenience and any confusion!!!
